command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=0ed1abcdcb6000c5a6a054b63bec40413e71e5b9; git fetch --quiet origin main agent-control; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import subprocess

old = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([
    'git', 'show',
    'origin/agent-control:.agent/tasks/20260901-c6-extract-device-state-v2.json'
], text=True))
for write in old['writes']:
    Path(write['path']).write_text(write['content'])

p = Path('main/zigbee_gateway.c')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('#include <limits.h>\n', '', 1)
s = s.replace('#include "gateway_events.h"\n', '#include "gateway_device_state.h"\n#include "gateway_events.h"\n', 1)
for define in ('#define GATEWAY_MAX_DEVICES 16U\n', '#define GATEWAY_MAX_ENDPOINTS_PER_DEVICE 8U\n', '#define GATEWAY_INVALID_SHORT_ADDR 0xffffU\n'):
    assert s.count(define) == 1, define
    s = s.replace(define, '', 1)

type_start = s.index('typedef enum { SLOT_EMPTY, SLOT_ACTIVE, SLOT_REJOIN_PENDING, SLOT_LEAVING } slot_state_t;')
type_end = s.index('typedef enum {\n    DISCOVERY_ACTIVE_ENDPOINTS,', type_start)
s = s[:type_start] + s[type_end:]
assert s.count('static device_slot_t s_devices[GATEWAY_MAX_DEVICES];\n') == 1
s = s.replace('static device_slot_t s_devices[GATEWAY_MAX_DEVICES];\n', '', 1)

helper_start = s.index('static bool ieee_matches(')
helper_end = s.index('static gateway_device_id_t device_from_header(', helper_start)
wrapper = '''static endpoint_state_t *endpoint_state(\n    device_slot_t *slot, uint8_t endpoint, bool create)\n{\n    endpoint_state_t *state = gateway_device_endpoint_state(slot, endpoint, create);\n    if (state == NULL && create && slot != NULL) {\n        warning(&slot->device, "endpoint state capacity exhausted");\n    }\n    return state;\n}\n\n'''
s = s[:helper_start] + wrapper + s[helper_end:]

s = s.replace('device_slot_t *slot = find_by_short(device.short_addr, false);', 'device_slot_t *slot = gateway_device_find_by_short(device.short_addr, false);')
s = s.replace('device_slot_t *slot = find_by_ieee(\n            &header->src_addr.u.extended_addr, false\n        );', 'device_slot_t *slot = gateway_device_find_by_ieee(\n            header->src_addr.u.extended_addr.u8, false\n        );')
s = s.replace('device_slot_t *slot = find_by_short(short_addr, false);', 'device_slot_t *slot = gateway_device_find_by_short(short_addr, false);')
s = s.replace('upsert_device(short_addr, &ieee)', 'gateway_device_upsert(short_addr, ieee.u8)')
s = s.replace('upsert_device(short_addr, NULL)', 'gateway_device_upsert(short_addr, NULL)')
s = s.replace('device_slot_t *slot = upsert_device(header->src_addr.u.short_addr, NULL);', 'device_slot_t *slot = gateway_device_upsert(header->src_addr.u.short_addr, NULL);')
s = s.replace('.device = ref_for(slot),', '.device = gateway_device_ref_for(slot),')
s = s.replace('from_ref(', 'gateway_device_from_ref(')
s = s.replace('maybe_reclaim(', 'gateway_device_maybe_reclaim(')
s = s.replace('ieee == NULL ? NULL : find_by_ieee(ieee, true)', 'ieee == NULL ? NULL : gateway_device_find_by_ieee(ieee->u8, true)')
s = s.replace('device_slot_t *slot = upsert_device(short_addr, ieee);', 'device_slot_t *slot = gateway_device_upsert(\n        short_addr, ieee == NULL ? NULL : ieee->u8);')
s = s.replace('slot = find_by_short(short_addr, true);', 'slot = gateway_device_find_by_short(short_addr, true);')
s = s.replace('device_slot_t *slot = find_by_ieee(&p->device_addr, false);', 'device_slot_t *slot = gateway_device_find_by_ieee(p->device_addr.u8, false);')
s = s.replace('slot = find_by_short(p->short_addr, false);', 'slot = gateway_device_find_by_short(p->short_addr, false);')
for name in ('find_by_ieee', 'find_by_short', 'ref_for', 'from_ref', 'maybe_reclaim', 'upsert_device'):
    assert re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])' + re.escape(name) + r'\(', s) is None, name
p.write_text(s)

cm = Path('main/CMakeLists.txt')
c = cm.read_text()
needle = '        "app_main.c"\n        "gateway_events.c"'
replacement = '        "app_main.c"\n        "gateway_device_state.c"\n        "gateway_events.c"'
assert c.count(needle) == 1
cm.write_text(c.replace(needle, replacement))

wf = Path('.github/workflows/quality.yml')
w = wf.read_text()
marker = '  host-reporting-policy:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n'
job = '''  host-device-state:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      - name: Build device state host tests\n        run: |\n          cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic \\\n            -Imain \\\n            tests/host/test_gateway_device_state.c \\\n            main/gateway_device_state.c \\\n            -o /tmp/test_gateway_device_state\n      - name: Run device state host tests\n        run: /tmp/test_gateway_device_state\n\n'''
assert w.count(marker) == 1
wf.write_text(w.replace(marker, job + marker))
PY
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Imain tests/host/test_gateway_device_state.c main/gateway_device_state.c -o /tmp/test_gateway_device_state; /tmp/test_gateway_device_state; cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Imain tests/host/test_gateway_reporting_policy.c main/gateway_reporting_policy.c -o /tmp/test_gateway_reporting_policy; /tmp/test_gateway_reporting_policy; cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -DGATEWAY_ZCL_HOST_TEST -Imain tests/host/test_gateway_zcl_value.c main/gateway_zcl_value.c -lm -o /tmp/test_gateway_zcl_value; /tmp/test_gateway_zcl_value; git diff --check; git diff --stat; git status --short
